annotations.statement: Both frozen Commercial Site Plan remodel clauses used “or site improvements”; the source says “nor site improvements” in each. The reviewed display corrects only those two words; original PASS1 bytes are unchanged.
annotations.limitation: This corrects a reviewer transcription, not the source, and does not interpret either condition.

annotations.statement: Withdraw the frozen p1/4-only date claim: 2-13-26 is visibly printed on all four physical pages. Page2 and page3 date crops were directly inspected; the rendered date-region pixels are identical across all four pages.
annotations.limitation: The source gives no explicit adoption/effective-date label. The cause of the original visual omission was not established.

annotations.statement: Withdraw the frozen no-letterhead-on-p2/p3 and no-Applications/Fees-on-p3 observations. All four pages contain the letterhead and Applications/Fees header; p2 and p3 top crops show these elements and have identical PNG bytes.
annotations.limitation: No native-hidden or absent-source-element conclusion is supported. Exact repeated-region pixel comparison supplements the direct crop review.

annotations.statement: The CCN, RCN fee has a visible short low horizontal mark between $150 and +. Its rectangle is preserved separately; native text reads $150 +. Reviewed display uses an underscore-like notation $150_+ with this qualification.
annotations.limitation: The graphic is not certified as an encoded underscore, subtraction sign, deletion, or numeric operator. No arithmetic or source repair is performed.

annotations.statement: Reviewed display joins soft wraps, normalizes visible bullets to hyphen-space and flattens superscript st/nd/rd. Every native UTF-8 byte remains unchanged and separately bound; the page1 native extractor adds one whitespace-only line without a matching text-dictionary geometry line.
annotations.limitation: Visual review does not certify exact Unicode glyph encodings. Nested categories remain attached to their physical application/fee cells.

annotations.statement: Metropolitan District Service Plan Review includes an hourly legal-review rate in addition to $500; Overall Development Plan has the annexation waiver note; all three Vacation bullets inherit “Note: fees per plat” and the Alley bullet retains the Road Vacation exception.
annotations.limitation: These are municipal schedule entries, not a district-issued schedule. No hourly rate, total, applicability decision or waiver beyond the literal source is inferred.

source_date_claim: 2-13-26 appears on all four pages without an explicit adoption/effective-date label
qualifications: 44 physical application rows contain 43 explicitly bound nested entries: 15 paired subcategories and 28 fee bullets. These are table-structure counts, not counts of legal requirements.
All 4923 native UTF-8 bytes across 243 lines are retained, including whitespace; no native byte or source PDF was cleaned or overwritten.

The eleven Rezoning category/fee pairs and six Commercial Site Plan bullets are preserved separately under their parent physical rows; identical fee wording on distinct Rezoning categories has distinct ordered source-line bindings.
Both $50 remodel clauses retain “nor site improvements”. The Subdivision text retains “$105 Plus per Lot (≥11)” and “Deferred Filing+” as printed; no formula or arithmetic interpretation is supplied.
The printed 2-13-26 date, HTTP receipt times and Content-Disposition filename are different evidence roles. No adopting instrument or independently verified legal-effective date was established.

Original HTTP receipts are copied from the separate frozen discovery package. This QA made no public request; no canonical intake, lookup release, monitoring enrollment or legal-currentness promotion is included.

The original Poppler attempt lacked usable fontconfig/cache and was interrupted after repeated errors; a second local render with explicit system-font configuration completed. Only the successful full-page renders are source-review evidence; the failed attempt is noted rather than treated as a rendering success.
The original two root crops are preserved byte-for-byte; their original crop-creation settings/times are not inferred. New independent crops have exact replayable settings.
